desc: The Berger Hybrid Target rifle ammunition is designed for optimal performance in precision long range rifles. The Hybrid target Rifle Bullet is one of the top performing Rifle Bullets in long range precision rifle target style competitions, and for good reason. It is an optimized hybrid design that has a very high BC for its weight and caliber. It is built around a J4 Precision Jacket, which are the most precise and concentric jackets in the world. This means a better balance of the Rifle Bullet, tighter groups, and more hits on target at extended ranges.
